title: Russia downs 320 drones: Six killed, warehouses damaged in Moscow, St Petersburg
summary_full: Russia’s defence ministry said it brought down or destroyed 320 Ukrainian drones across 19 regions overnight, as governors reported six people killed, nine injured and warehouses damaged near Moscow and St Petersburg.
